summary: Wrote a 6-phase, 5.5-hour implementation plan for the foreign-stash-pop guard, adopting the research report's stash-sha-set diffing mechanism (which covers git-snapshot.sh's subprocess-invisible internal stash) and its stash_pop_foreign grant-class reuse. The plan corrects one placement defect in the research recommendation: the new pop/apply predicate must be tree-state-blind and sit BEFORE guard-destructive-git.sh's clean-tree early exit, since a foreign pop on a clean tree is the most dangerous case. Phases: provenance lib+PostToolUse hook, grant-class registration, the guard predicate, the four acceptance fixtures, docs, then redeploy plus the full gate set.

artifacts.summary: 6-phase plan (waves [1,2] -> [3] -> [4,5] -> [6]) for session-scoped stash provenance and a foreign-pop refusal in guard-destructive-git.sh.
